decisions.claim: Which two semantic additions did GDT665 remove, and was their removal an empirical rejection or an internal composition correction?
decisions.reviewer: root source review with independent companion audit
decisions.scope: Exactly two semantic additions across the four named forms, represented by this existing joint card. Do not propagate to every OL, Y, portion or related material gloss. Four nonexistent role fixes, rival-annotation leakage and unsplit overcompositions are separately reported engineering consequences, not additional meaning failures.
decisions.actually_tested_falsifier: The first synthesis embedded naked learned OL=Grundansatz inside okol/okoldy at 60 positions and added one portion to ykeey/ykaiin at 92 positions. The final audit removes both additions while licensing each remaining declared atom and reconstructing its surface.
decisions.outcome: Historical internally unsupported composition/wording withdrawn. Neither surface reconstruction nor a licensed role sheet independently falsifies those manuscript meanings. The evidence is specific to the chosen component inventory and the two removed additions.
decisions.claim_ceiling: Historical scoped question only; no manuscript meaning confirmation or automatic status propagation.

reopening.criteria_origin: Source-question prospective conditions, not a new experiment preregistration.
all_of: For an internal renderer revision, supply a documented role/source correction licensing the exact embedded OL or one-portion addition while preserving the declared segmentation and surface. That would reopen internal consistency only. Reinstating either addition as a manuscript meaning requires independent evidence for that exact whole construction or its licensed composition, not bare OL gloss reuse or surface roundtrip success. Additional counts alone do not change either requirement.
not_sufficient: More positions with the same inherited glosses.
A licensed internal recipe or successful surface reconstruction treated as semantic gold.
Changing a threshold after seeing the same result.

| Form | bisherige Prosa | Quelle | damalige Konstruktion |
|---|---|---|---|
| `qokeol` | erhitze den Drogenstoff bis zur Mittelstufe | GDT666, `G666-D149` | `QO_COMMAND+K_HOT+E_MIDDLE+OL_MATERIAL` |
| `okeol` | Grundansatz bis zur mittleren Heizstufe erwärmt | GDT664, `G664-D030` | `O_PREP+K_HOT+E_MIDDLE+OL_BASE` |

Beide Karten waren ausdrücklich `PRODUCTIVE_COMPOUND` und ersetzbare
Werkstattwerte. Die konkrete Handlung, der Drogenstoff und der Grundansatz
wurden also aus Analystenbausteinen zusammengesetzt; sie wurden nicht als
unabhängige Bedeutungen der beiden Ganzformen gefunden. Der heutige
No-component-export-Renderer darf diese Karten deshalb nicht als Bestätigung
seiner eigenen Bausteine verwenden.
